WITH sal AS (
 SELECT d.fiscal_year fy, s.store_id, sum(f.net_amount) gross_net, sum(case when f.staff_purchase_flag then f.net_amount else 0 end) staff
 FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=f.sale_date JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
 WHERE d.fiscal_period=4 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26','FY2026/27') AND s.store_id<900 GROUP BY ALL),
ret AS (
 SELECT d.fiscal_year fy, s.store_id, sum(r.refund_net) rn
 FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=r.return_date JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=r.store_key
 WHERE d.fiscal_period=4 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26','FY2026/27') AND s.store_id<900 GROUP BY ALL),
rpt AS (
 SELECT d.fiscal_year fy, store_id, sum(net_sales_before_returns) nsbr, sum(returns_net) rrn, sum(net_sales) ns, count(*) days
 FROM rpt_daily_store_sales r JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=r.business_date
 WHERE d.fiscal_period=4 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26','FY2026/27') GROUP BY ALL)
SELECT coalesce(sal.fy,rpt.fy) fy, coalesce(sal.store_id,rpt.store_id) st, sal.gross_net, ret.rn, sal.staff, rpt.nsbr, rpt.rrn, rpt.ns, rpt.days
FROM sal FULL JOIN rpt ON sal.fy=rpt.fy AND sal.store_id=rpt.store_id LEFT JOIN ret ON ret.fy=coalesce(sal.fy,rpt.fy) AND ret.store_id=coalesce(sal.store_id,rpt.store_id)
ORDER BY 2,1

SELECT store_id, 
 min(case when business_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-07-28' AND DATE '2025-08-24' then receipts end) min_r_py,
 min(case when business_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-03' AND DATE '2026-08-30' then receipts end) min_r_cy,
 sum(case when business_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-07-28' AND DATE '2025-08-24' then receipts end) r_py,
 sum(case when business_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-03' AND DATE '2026-08-30' then receipts end) r_cy,
 sum(case when business_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-07-28' AND DATE '2025-08-24' then units_sold end) u_py,
 sum(case when business_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-03' AND DATE '2026-08-30' then units_sold end) u_cy
FROM rpt_daily_store_sales WHERE store_id<900 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH per AS (
 SELECT
  (SELECT period_start_date FROM ref_fiscal_calendar WHERE fiscal_year='FY2025/26' AND fiscal_period=4) py_start,
  (SELECT period_end_date FROM ref_fiscal_calendar WHERE fiscal_year='FY2025/26' AND fiscal_period=4) py_end,
  (SELECT period_start_date FROM ref_fiscal_calendar WHERE fiscal_year='FY2026/27' AND fiscal_period=4) cy_start,
  (SELECT period_end_date FROM ref_fiscal_calendar WHERE fiscal_year='FY2026/27' AND fiscal_period=4) cy_end),
stores AS (
 SELECT DISTINCT s.store_id FROM dim_store s, per
 WHERE s.is_current AND s.store_id < 900
  AND (s.open_date IS NULL OR s.open_date < per.py_start)
  AND (s.close_date IS NULL OR s.close_date > per.cy_end)
  AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ref_store_closure c WHERE c.store_id=s.store_id AND ((c.closure_start_date<=per.py_end AND c.closure_end_date>=per.py_start) OR (c.closure_start_date<=per.cy_end AND c.closure_end_date>=per.cy_start)))),
daily AS (
 SELECT business_date, store_id, net_sales FROM rpt_daily_store_sales),
agg AS (
 SELECT st.store_id,
  sum(case when d.business_date BETWEEN per.py_start AND per.py_end then d.net_sales end) py,
  sum(case when d.business_date BETWEEN per.cy_start AND per.cy_end then d.net_sales end) cy
 FROM stores st JOIN daily d ON d.store_id=st.store_id, per GROUP BY 1)
SELECT count(*) n, sum(py) py, sum(cy) cy, round(100*(sum(cy)/sum(py)-1),2) growth_pct,
 round(100*(sum(case when store_id NOT IN (136,137) then cy end)/sum(case when store_id NOT IN (136,137) then py end)-1),2) excl_new,
 round(100*(sum(case when store_id<>125 then cy end)/sum(case when store_id<>125 then py end)-1),2) excl_125,
 round(100*(sum(case when store_id NOT IN (125,136,137) then cy end)/sum(case when store_id NOT IN (125,136,137) then py end)-1),2) excl_both,
 string_agg(cast(store_id as varchar), ',' ORDER BY store_id) ids
FROM agg

WITH per AS (
 SELECT
  (SELECT period_start_date FROM ref_fiscal_calendar WHERE fiscal_year='FY2025/26' AND fiscal_period=4) py_start,
  (SELECT period_end_date FROM ref_fiscal_calendar WHERE fiscal_year='FY2025/26' AND fiscal_period=4) py_end,
  (SELECT period_start_date FROM ref_fiscal_calendar WHERE fiscal_year='FY2026/27' AND fiscal_period=4) cy_start,
  (SELECT period_end_date FROM ref_fiscal_calendar WHERE fiscal_year='FY2026/27' AND fiscal_period=4) cy_end),
lfl_stores AS (
 SELECT DISTINCT s.store_id FROM dim_store s, per
 WHERE s.is_current AND s.store_id < 900
  AND (s.open_date IS NULL OR s.open_date < per.py_start)
  AND (s.close_date IS NULL OR s.close_date > per.cy_end)
  AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ref_store_closure c WHERE c.store_id=s.store_id AND ((c.closure_start_date<=per.py_end AND c.closure_end_date>=per.py_start) OR (c.closure_start_date<=per.cy_end AND c.closure_end_date>=per.cy_start)))),
agg AS (
 SELECT sum(case when d.business_date BETWEEN per.py_start AND per.py_end then d.net_sales end) py,
        sum(case when d.business_date BETWEEN per.cy_start AND per.cy_end then d.net_sales end) cy
 FROM lfl_stores st JOIN rpt_daily_store_sales d ON d.store_id=st.store_id, per)
SELECT 'FY2026/27' AS fiscal_year, 4 AS fiscal_period, round(100*(cy/py-1),2) AS lfl_net_sales_growth_pct FROM agg
